gen-fs-oswald-gf-varela-round: Oswald packs its letters into tight, confident rows with real muscle. Varela Round does the opposite job, drawing soft, uniform strokes around wide-mouthed rounds that feel modern and clean.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-noto-sans-carian: Marker-tip friendly, Chubbo curves smoothly with uniform strokes, while Noto Sans Carian stands taller in the lowercase. Let the sans text sit a size or two below the heading.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-varta: Confident and tightly knit, Oswald makes a strong, compact display heading. Varta, with big open eyes on its e and a, reads well at a slightly generous size on the page.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Casual and inviting, Chubbo draws smooth marker-like curves with no hairlines anywhere, while Noto Sans Gothic opens its lowercase counters wide. Together the page gets friendly weight above and open sans below.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-vazirmatn: Easygoing and modern, the sans text opens its s wide and never tightens up. Vazirmatn carries on that way for pages, while Oswald stays packed in strong, confident rows above.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha keeps its tall little letters flowing without snagging. Chubbo is at its best in casual, smooth marker curves, whereas the body font excels at tall, snag-free lowercase.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-wix-madefor-display: Confident Oswald sets a strong, tightly knit tone up top. Wix Madefor Display slips in quietly beneath with gently flared curve ends that stay apart, leaving the heading firmly in charge.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Inviting Chubbo draws its curves like a single thread of ink. Noto Sans Gujarati stands taller beneath it, ending its curves before they turn inward and leaving large open counters.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-wix-madefor-text: Strong and confident, Oswald packs tightly knit rows up top, while Wix Madefor Text brings open terminals that read easily. Let the plain sans text go a notch larger.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gondi: Chubbo draws every bend smooth, as if with a marker tip. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi stands out most for its tall lowercase, with terminals cut back to leave a big gap.
